annotation.title_clean: 無人航空機の飛行に関する許可・承認の審査要領（カテゴリーⅡ飛行）
annotation.title_en: Review Guidelines for Permission/Approval of Unmanned Aircraft Flight (Category II Flight)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Civil Aviation Bureau, Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT), Japan
annotation.summary_en: Japan's MLIT review guidelines for permissions and approvals of Category II unmanned aircraft (drone) flights under the Civil Aeolian Aviation Act. They set application procedures, aircraft performance, pilot competence, safety-system standards, and additional criteria for night, beyond-visual-line-of-sight, over-event and cargo-drop flights, with application forms.
key_provisions_or_claims: Permission needed for flight in prohibited airspace and approval for specified flight methods (night, BVLOS, near people, events, dangerous goods, drop).
Aircraft must meet functional standards; 25kg+ aircraft face additional failsafe and data recording requirements.
Pilots need 10+ hours experience and knowledge/skills, or a pilot competency certificate.
BVLOS without observers requires access-control zones, failsafe functions and third-party liability insurance (Level 3.5).
Flights over event venues require exclusion zones scaled by altitude and wind limits.
